description: List the supported instruments for one Blocksize service. This is free, read-only catalog metadata; it does not fetch live prices, create accounts, or start x402 payment.

limit.description: Maximum instruments to return. Use offset to traverse the stable catalog without requesting the entire upstream array.

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the sorted instrument catalog.

service.description: Blocksize service namespace to list: vwap for crypto VWAP pairs, bidask for shared bid/ask symbols including supported equities, fx for FX pairs, or metal for metals.

name: list_instruments
title: Instrument List
